mandate: Keep signs and units consistent in prose and ledger. Check equations against stated totals;flag source unit/number-format conflicts instead of silently rescaling.
trigger: A repeated equation or per-unit calculation.
evidence: Current capture figures,unit labels,period and scope.
exceptions: Allow explicitly stated rounding/conditional scale with a labeled residual.
double_count_risk: Do not add inclusive subtotals and their components.
point: Common section prompt;no new parser or SQLite rule.

mandate: Do not request ordinary Stage1/2 SICR migrations for POCI;still investigate applicable lifetime-loss changes,recovery assumptions and disclosed classifications.
exceptions: Issuer-specific credit-impaired labels and legitimate POCI credit-risk disclosure remain relevant.
double_count_risk: Separate signed cumulative changes from ordinary loss coverage.
fail: Demand conventional Stage1/2 movement table for a POCI-only portfolio.
pass_example: Reconcile lifetime-loss changes and assumptions on the POCI basis.
point: Existing conditional sector note;check duplicate/conflicting approved rules before any SQLite proposal.

mandate: First-time comparative presentation alone does not establish restatement,policy change or unreliable reporting. Distinguish explicit notice or independently evidenced error from unknown causes.
evidence: Footnote,comparative figures and any error/methodology notice actually inspected.
exceptions: An independently demonstrated source inconsistency can be flagged without management admission.
double_count_risk: Do not duplicate one issue as separate policy/error/quality allegations.
fail: First-time presentation means unreliable or restated.
pass_example: First-time presentation noted;cause of zero rate remains open.
point: Common section prompt;no automatic financial guardrail codification.
